title: 3v3 One-Push Maximum Game
description: A half-court 3v3 limiting every player to a short burst of pushes per touch, speeding up decision-making and ball movement.

content.objective: Speed up decision-making by limiting every touch to a short push before passing or shooting.
content.setup: Three offensive players face three defenders in a half-court game with the push limited.
instructions: Play live 3v3 to a target score.
Each player may push at most two strokes per touch before passing or shooting.
A third push on the same touch results in a turnover.
Rotate teams after every four possessions.
coachingPoints: Catch already thinking about the next pass, not just the push.
Move without the ball to create easy short-push advantages.
Use the limited push purposefully — toward the rim or to improve a passing angle.
commonMistakes: Taking the pushes immediately out of habit instead of looking to pass first.
Sitting still and forcing a tough shot rather than passing to a better-positioned teammate.
Ignoring the game's constraint once the pressure is on.
content.safety: Keep contact controlled; call fouls to maintain a fair pace.
